items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: The drummer was Romeo L. Thomas.

ctx.x: The drummer was Romeo L. Thomas. And the other boy, and I don't forget the boy play guitar. I don't forget his name. But anyway, the first name was Noon. But the last name I forgot was about the guitar player.
And what instrument were you playing?
